pm_schedule_check.name: pm_schedule_check
pm_schedule_check.value: (asset_id IS NOT NULL) OR (space_id IS NOT NULL)

work_order_check.name: work_order_check
work_order_check.value: (ticket_id IS NOT NULL) OR (pm_schedule_id IS NOT NULL)

vendor_ranking_check.name: vendor_ranking_check
vendor_ranking_check.value: (NOT is_selected) OR (rank = 1) OR (selection_reason IS NOT NULL)

generated.as: ((((((basic_amount - discount_amount) + cgst_amount) + sgst_amount) + igst_amount) + freight_amount) + other_charges)
(((((((((basic_amount - discount_amount) + cgst_amount) + sgst_amount) + igst_amount) + freight_amount) + other_charges) - tds_amount) - retention_amount) - advance_adjusted)

ck_reg_no_present.name: ck_reg_no_present
ck_reg_no_present.value: registration_no IS NOT NULL)) NOT VALID

hostel_allocation_check.name: hostel_allocation_check
hostel_allocation_check.value: ((occupant_type = 'Student'::hostel.occupant_type) AND (student_id IS NOT NULL) AND (staff_id IS NULL)) OR ((occupant_type = 'Staff'::hostel.occupant_type) AND (staff_id IS NOT NULL) AND (student_id IS NULL))

room_handover_check.name: room_handover_check
room_handover_check.value: (handover_type <> 'Check_Out'::hostel.handover_type) OR ((key_returned IS NOT NULL) AND (vacate_id IS NOT NULL))

ck_receipt_no_present.name: ck_receipt_no_present
ck_receipt_no_present.value: receipt_no IS NOT NULL)) NOT VALID

sick_leave_check1.name: sick_leave_check1
sick_leave_check1.value: (status = ANY (ARRAY['Applied'::hostel.sick_leave_status, 'Rejected'::hostel.sick_leave_status])) OR ((visited_by IS NOT NULL) AND (visited_at IS NOT NULL) AND (visit_remarks IS NOT NULL))

ck_outpass_no_present.name: ck_outpass_no_present
ck_outpass_no_present.value: outpass_no IS NOT NULL)) NOT VALID

sick_meal_delivery_check.name: sick_meal_delivery_check
sick_meal_delivery_check.value: (status <> 'Delivered'::hostel.delivery_status) OR ((delivered_by IS NOT NULL) AND (delivered_at IS NOT NULL))

portal.v_po_total.name: v_po_total
portal.v_po_total.definition: SELECT po_id, sum(round(qty * unit_price * (1::numeric - discount_pct / 100::numeric), 2)) AS sub_total, sum(round(qty * unit_price * (1::numeric - discount_pct / 100::numeric) * (cgst_pct + sgst_pct + igst_pct) / 100::numeric, 2)) AS tax_amount, sum(round(qty * unit_price * (1::numeric - discount_pct / 100::numeric) * (1::numeric + (cgst_pct + sgst_pct + igst_pct) / 100::numeric), 2)) AS grand_total FROM portal.po_line GROUP BY po_id

hostel.v_student_dues.name: v_student_dues
hostel.v_student_dues.definition: SELECT student_id, fee_head, count(*) AS demands, sum(amount_due) AS amount_due, sum(amount_paid) AS amount_paid, sum(amount_due - amount_paid) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'Waived'::hostel.demand_status) AS balance, min(due_date) FILTER (WHERE status = ANY (ARRAY['Pending'::hostel.demand_status, 'Part_Paid'::hostel.demand_status, 'Overdue'::hostel.demand_status])) AS earliest_due FROM hostel.fee_demand d GROUP BY student_id, fee_head

hostel.v_bed.name: v_bed
hostel.v_bed.definition: SELECT ss.subspace_id, ss.subspace_code AS bed_code, ss.status AS bed_status, s.space_id, s.space_code AS room_code, s.space_name AS room_name, s.status AS room_status, z.zone_id, z.zone_name AS floor_name, z.sequence_no AS floor_no, f.facility_id, f.facility_name AS hostel_name, hp.hostel_code, hp.hostel_gender, rp.room_type_id, rt.type_name, rt.sharing_count, rt.is_ac, rp.is_accessible, rp.reserved_for, a.hostel_alloc_id, a.occupant_type, a.student_id, a.staff_id, a.allocation_date FROM infra.subspace ss JOIN infra.space s ON s.space_id::text = ss.space_id::text JOIN infra.zone z ON z.zone_id::text = s.zone_id::text JOIN infra.facility f ON f.facility_id::text = z.facility_id::text JOIN hostel.hostel_profile hp ON hp.facility_id::text = f.facility_id::text LEFT JOIN hostel.room_profile rp ON rp.space_id::text = s.space_id::text LEFT JOIN hostel.room_type rt ON rt.room_type_id = rp.room_type_id LEFT JOIN hostel.hostel_allocation a ON a.subspace_id::text = ss.subspace_id::text AND a.status = 'Active'::hostel.allocation_status WHERE ss.subspace_type = 'Bed'::infra.subspace_type AND s.space_category = 'Hostel_Room'::infra.space_category

hostel.v_vacancy.name: v_vacancy
hostel.v_vacancy.definition: SELECT facility_id, hostel_name, hostel_code, hostel_gender, room_type_id, type_name, count(*) FILTER (WHERE bed_status = 'Vacant'::infra.subspace_status AND room_status <> 'Under_Maintenance'::infra.space_status AND reserved_for = 'None'::hostel.reserved_for) AS vacant_beds, count(*) FILTER (WHERE bed_status = 'Held'::infra.subspace_status) AS held_beds, count(*) FILTER (WHERE bed_status = 'Occupied'::infra.subspace_status) AS occupied_beds, count(*) AS total_beds FROM hostel.v_bed GROUP BY facility_id, hostel_name, hostel_code, hostel_gender, room_type_id, type_name

hostel.v_registration.name: v_registration
hostel.v_registration.definition: SELECT r.registration_id, r.registration_no, r.student_id, sm.full_name, sm.gender, sm.programme, r.academic_year, r.facility_id, hp.hostel_code, r.room_type_id, rt.type_name, r.status, r.applied_on, r.waitlist_no, rd.status AS registration_fee_status, rd.amount_due AS registration_fee, fp.fee_plan_id, fp.plan_type, fp.status AS plan_status, ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(d.amount_due), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce" FROM hostel.fee_demand d WHERE d.fee_plan_id = fp.fee_plan_id) AS plan_amount_due, ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(d.amount_paid), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce" FROM hostel.fee_demand d WHERE d.fee_plan_id = fp.fee_plan_id) AS plan_amount_paid, o.offer_id, o.subspace_id, o.student_decision, o.hold_until, a.hostel_alloc_id, a.allocation_date, a.key_no FROM hostel.hostel_registration r JOIN ref.student_master sm ON sm.student_id::text = r.student_id::text JOIN hostel.hostel_profile hp ON hp.facility_id::text = r.facility_id::text JOIN hostel.room_type rt ON rt.room_type_id = r.room_type_id LEFT JOIN hostel.fee_demand rd ON rd.demand_id = r.reg_demand_id LEFT JOIN hostel.fee_plan fp ON fp.registration_id = r.registration_id LEFT JOIN hostel.room_offer o ON o.registration_id = r.registration_id AND (o.student_decision = ANY (ARRAY['Pending'::hostel.student_decision, 'Accepted'::hostel.student_decision])) LEFT JOIN hostel.hostel_allocation a ON a.offer_id = o.offer_id

hostel.v_floors_without_warden.name: v_floors_without_warden
hostel.v_floors_without_warden.definition: SELECT facility_id, hostel_name, zone_id, floor_name, count(*) AS occupied_beds FROM hostel.v_bed b WHERE bed_status = 'Occupied'::infra.subspace_status AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM hostel.staff_space_assignment a WHERE a.facility_id::text = b.facility_id::text AND a.zone_id::text = b.zone_id::text AND a.hostel_role::text = 'Floor_Warden'::text AND a.status = 'Active'::hostel.assignment_status)) GROUP BY facility_id, hostel_name, zone_id, floor_name

hostel.v_space_qr_page.name: v_space_qr_page
hostel.v_space_qr_page.definition: SELECT q.qr_token, s.space_id, s.space_code, s.space_name, s.space_category, z.zone_name, f.facility_name, a.hostel_role, st.full_name, st.mobile_no, a.shift FROM hostel.space_qr q JOIN infra.space s ON s.space_id::text = q.space_id::text JOIN infra.zone z ON z.zone_id::text = s.zone_id::text JOIN infra.facility f ON f.facility_id::text = z.facility_id::text JOIN hostel.staff_space_assignment a ON a.facility_id::text = f.facility_id::text AND a.status = 'Active'::hostel.assignment_status AND a.show_on_qr AND (a.space_id::text = s.space_id::text OR a.space_id IS NULL AND (a.zone_id::text = z.zone_id::text OR a.zone_id IS NULL)) JOIN ref.staff_master st ON st.staff_id::text = a.staff_id::text WHERE q.status = 'Active'::hostel.qr_status

hostel.v_student_location.name: v_student_location
hostel.v_student_location.definition: SELECT sm.student_id, sm.full_name, sm.gender, sm.programme, st.facility_id, st.zone_id, st.space_id, st.subspace_id, cs.current_status, cs.last_event_at, cp.point_name AS last_point, me.direction AS last_direction FROM ref.student_master sm JOIN LATERAL hostel.fn_student_stay(sm.student_id) st(hostel_alloc_id, subspace_id, space_id, zone_id, facility_id) ON true LEFT JOIN hostel.student_current_status cs ON cs.student_id::text = sm.student_id::text LEFT JOIN hostel.movement_event me ON me.event_id = cs.last_event_id AND me.event_at = cs.last_event_at LEFT JOIN hostel.capture_point cp ON cp.point_id = me.point_id WHERE sm.is_hosteller

hostel.v_mess_sick_list.name: v_mess_sick_list
hostel.v_mess_sick_list.definition: SELECT d.meal_date, d.slot, sl.sick_leave_id, sl.student_id, sm.full_name, st.facility_id, st.space_id, ms.mess_id, ms.cuisine, d.status, d.delivered_by, d.delivered_at FROM hostel.sick_meal_delivery d JOIN hostel.sick_leave sl ON sl.sick_leave_id = d.sick_leave_id AND sl.status = 'Approved'::hostel.sick_leave_status JOIN ref.student_master sm ON sm.student_id::text = sl.student_id::text LEFT JOIN LATERAL hostel.fn_student_stay(sl.student_id) st(hostel_alloc_id, subspace_id, space_id, zone_id, facility_id) ON true LEFT JOIN hostel.mess_subscription ms ON ms.student_id::text = sl.student_id::text AND ms.status = 'Active'::hostel.subscription_status

hostel.v_outpass.name: v_outpass
hostel.v_outpass.definition: SELECT o.outpass_id, o.outpass_no, o.student_id, sm.full_name, st.facility_id, st.zone_id, o.reason, o.destination, o.leave_from, o.return_by, o.outing_category, o.levels_required, o.contact_during_leave, o.status, o.qr_token, o.actual_out_at, o.actual_in_at, o.late_by_minutes, o.applied_on, ( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('level', s.level, 'role', s.approver_role, 'decision', s.decision, 'by', COALESCE(st_1.full_name, (((c.contact_name::text || ' ('::text) || c.relation) || ')'::text)::character varying), 'on', s.decided_on, 'remarks', s.remarks) ORDER BY s.level) AS jsonb_agg FROM shared.approval_step s LEFT JOIN ref.staff_master st_1 ON st_1.staff_id::text = s.acted_by::text LEFT JOIN hostel.student_contact c ON c.contact_id = s.acted_by_contact WHERE s.request_type = 'Outpass'::shared.request_type AND s.request_id = o.outpass_id) AS steps FROM hostel.outpass o JOIN ref.student_master sm ON sm.student_id::text = o.student_id::text LEFT JOIN LATERAL hostel.fn_student_stay(o.student_id) st(hostel_alloc_id, subspace_id, space_id, zone_id, facility_id) ON true

hostel.v_meter_position.name: v_meter_position
hostel.v_meter_position.definition: SELECT rm.meter_id, rm.meter_no, rm.space_id, s.space_code, rp.room_type_id, lr.reading_kwh AS last_reading, lr.reading_at AS last_reading_at, COALESCE(mo.reading_kwh, fm.reading_kwh) AS month_opening, lr.reading_kwh - COALESCE(mo.reading_kwh, fm.reading_kwh) AS units_this_month, t.included_units_per_month, rc.units AS recharged_this_month, COALESCE(t.included_units_per_month, 0::numeric) + rc.units - COALESCE(lr.reading_kwh - COALESCE(mo.reading_kwh, fm.reading_kwh), 0::numeric) AS units_left, t.rate_per_unit FROM hostel.room_meter rm JOIN infra.space s ON s.space_id::text = rm.space_id::text JOIN hostel.room_profile rp ON rp.space_id::text = rm.space_id::text LEFT JOIN hostel.electricity_tariff t ON t.room_type_id = rp.room_type_id AND t.approved_by IS NOT NULL AND CURRENT_DATE >= t.effective_from AND (t.effective_to IS NULL OR CURRENT_DATE <= t.effective_to) LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT r.reading_kwh, r.reading_at FROM hostel.meter_reading r WHERE r.meter_id = rm.meter_id ORDER BY r.reading_at DESC LIMIT 1) lr ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT r.reading_kwh FROM hostel.meter_reading r WHERE r.meter_id = rm.meter_id AND r.reading_at < date_trunc('month'::text, now()) ORDER BY r.reading_at DESC LIMIT 1) mo ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT r.reading_kwh FROM hostel.meter_reading r WHERE r.meter_id = rm.meter_id AND r.reading_at >= date_trunc('month'::text, now()) ORDER BY r.reading_at LIMIT 1) fm ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(mr.units_credited), 0::numeric) AS units FROM hostel.meter_recharge mr WHERE mr.meter_id = rm.meter_id AND (mr.status = ANY (ARRAY['Paid'::hostel.recharge_status, 'Credited'::hostel.recharge_status])) AND date_trunc('month'::text, mr.created_at) = date_trunc('month'::text, now())) rc ON true WHERE rm.status = 'Active'::hostel.meter_status

hostel.v_rpt_occupancy_fees_dues.name: v_rpt_occupancy_fees_dues
hostel.v_rpt_occupancy_fees_dues.definition: SELECT facility_id, hostel_name, hostel_code, sum(total_beds) AS total_beds, sum(occupied_beds) AS occupied_beds, sum(vacant_beds) AS vacant_beds, sum(held_beds) AS held_beds, ( SELECT count(*) AS count FROM hostel.hostel_registration r WHERE r.facility_id::text = v.facility_id::text AND (r.status <> ALL (ARRAY['Cancelled'::hostel.registration_status, 'Vacated'::hostel.registration_status]))) AS registrations, ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(d.amount_due), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce" FROM hostel.fee_demand d JOIN hostel.hostel_registration r ON r.student_id::text = d.student_id::text AND r.facility_id::text = v.facility_id::text) AS demanded, ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(d.amount_paid), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce" FROM hostel.fee_demand d JOIN hostel.hostel_registration r ON r.student_id::text = d.student_id::text AND r.facility_id::text = v.facility_id::text) AS collected, ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(d.amount_due - d.amount_paid), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce" FROM hostel.fee_demand d JOIN hostel.hostel_registration r ON r.student_id::text = d.student_id::text AND r.facility_id::text = v.facility_id::text WHERE d.status = 'Overdue'::hostel.demand_status) AS overdue, ( SELECT count(DISTINCT d.student_id) AS count FROM hostel.fee_demand d JOIN hostel.hostel_registration r ON r.student_id::text = d.student_id::text AND r.facility_id::text = v.facility_id::text WHERE d.status = 'Overdue'::hostel.demand_status) AS students_overdue FROM hostel.v_vacancy v GROUP BY facility_id, hostel_name, hostel_code
